errors.text_span: “近”距离下，“本文方法”柱高约为59.3%，基线模型约为59.0%；在“中”距离下，“本文方法”约为59.2%，基线模型约为58.7%；在“远”距离下，“本文方法”约为58.9%，基线模型约为56.2%。
errors.evidence: The bar heights are only approximate, but several reported values are slightly off: the left bars are around 59.4, 59.2, and 58.9; the right bars are around 59.0, 58.7, and 56.2. These are close enough that they are minor numerical approximation errors.
